permissions.description: Real, enforced permission codes — see src/auth/permissions.ts. Use ['*'] via the default Owner role, not here, for full access.

resourceType.description: Scopes this role to a single Category or Location (ADR-023) instead of the whole organization. Requires resourceId. Only meaningfully enforced for the one permission each type covers (CATEGORY -> products:write, LOCATION -> inventory:write) — see src/auth/scope.util.ts.

resourceId.description: The Category or Location id this role is scoped to. Required if resourceType is set.
